data.body:
[P2] Check the operation before classifying a not-found error

On a later session job using SSO credentials, credential refresh can raise `ResourceNotFoundException` from `GetRoleCredentials` before `CreateMicrovmAuthToken` reaches Lambda. Checking only the error code incorrectly reports the MicroVM as removed, discards the credential failure's message from the checkpoint, and passes `MicrovmStateError` to custom retry strategies instead of the original `ClientError`. Require `is_microvms_service_error("CreateMicrovmAuthToken", error)` alongside the code check, and add a regression test where token creation propagates a credential-provider not-found error.
